pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions are predominantly irregular polygons with complex, non-linear boundaries. Edge gradients are soft and exhibit smooth pixel transitions rather than sharp boundaries. Patch area is highest in the mid-flank and reduces significantly in scale toward the posterior and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous, interconnected topological web. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. Corridor thickness is non-uniform, decreasing in pixel width toward the hindquarters while maintaining network continuity throughout the visible frame.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The dorsal mane presents a continuous 1D serrated contour with low-amplitude, high-frequency peaks formed by individual hair clusters against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A linear horizontal textural disruption is visible across the mid-flank, intersecting multiple dark patches, suggestive of a superficial cutaneous mark or healed scratch.
